Usage: gotools init [options]

  Bootstrap the project with a .gotools.json manifest. If the root go.mod
  declares tools via 'go get -tool', they are adopted automatically (installed
  into gotools, directives stripped, go.mod tidied) unless --no-migrate is
  given.

  Running init again keeps what the manifest already says: a value is changed
  only by its flag. The environment steers one run and is never written to the
  manifest.

  Examples:
    gotools init
    gotools init --strategy=module --dir=.tools
    gotools init --go=1.24 --prefix=github.com/me/repo

  Options:
    --strategy <string>  Isolation strategy: unified, split or module (default: "split")
    --dir <string>       Tools directory (default: "tools")
    --go <string>        Go version for tools, or inherit (default: "inherit")
    --prefix <string>    Module path prefix (default: auto from go.mod)
    --no-migrate         Leave the root go.mod untouched
    --dry-run            Print the plan without writing anything
